summary:
Phase 2 optimization plan with 2 parts:
Part A: Database — optimize ~35 RLS policies (auth_rls_initplan fix) and add missing RLS policies for 4 tables.
Part B: Project cleanup — delete 11+ unused files, consolidate 17+ root docs into docs/, archive 60+ SQL scripts, delete test/debug routes, and split `lib/services.ts` (742 lines) into domain-specific modules with a barrel re-export.
